descriptions.zh: 是时候调查到底是什么导致[Root.GetName]殖民地上的居民做出如此奇怪而具有攻击性的行为了。
descriptions.en: It's high time to investigate what's causing the strange and destructive behavior of the [Root.GetName] colony.

descriptions.zh: 我们的科学家将针对这些洞穴蘑菇的原始效应进行研究，以寻找到对我们有利的利用方式。
descriptions.en: Our scientists will try to find ways to use the primal effects of the Cave Mushrooms to our benefit.

descriptions.zh: 将发起一项计划，将这些地下洞穴中的菌类逐步焚烧直到完全清理干净。
descriptions.en: A project will be initialized in which the fungus in the underground caves will be progressively incinerated down to the last spore.

descriptions.zh: 能与§Y小信使§!古怪的科技水平与容量相提并论的就是它可笑的规模了。数千个建造它的渺小生物才能塞满飞船，但如果我们想要塞进最小规格的船员还必须要对其进行大规模的改造。
descriptions.en: The extraordinary level of technology and capacity of §YThe Lesser Messenger§! can only be rivaled by it's ridiculous scale. Of the ship's tiny creator species thousands could fit into the vessel, but to fit even a skeleton crew of our species in there is going to require a massive overhaul.

descriptions.zh: 我们应该对之前从星门中射出来的未知物体造成的坠毁点进行一番更加细致的考察。
descriptions.en: We should take a closer look at the crash site of the unidentified object that was expelled from the gateway a while ago.

descriptions.zh: 根据之前在一次考古发掘中发现的外星人蓝图，我们可以组装一个构件，稍微地打开位于我们母星系的星门，我们的一艘科研船可以从中穿过。
descriptions.en: Following the alien blueprint found in a previous archaeological excavation, we can assemble a construction that will briefly open the gateway in our home system allow a Science Ship to pass through.

descriptions.zh: 古代聚变推进器航迹有待进一步研究。有可能从这里分析出留下这样的能量排放痕迹的船只的目的地。
descriptions.en: The ancient fusion drive trail should be studied further. It may be possible to isolate the destination of whatever vessel left this energy exhaust.

descriptions.zh: 尽管存在明显的损坏，但这个神秘的空间站仍可能包含古代信息或数据碎片，我们或许能将这些信息或数据碎片拼接在一起，对千百年前这里发生的事情做一个连贯的解释。
descriptions.en: Despite the obvious devastation, the enigmatic space station may contain old messages or data fragments that can be puzzled together into a coherent explanation for what happened here, eons ago.

descriptions.zh: 我们发现了曾经造就我们祖先的物种的后代……原始人。这些人现在已陷入蒙昧。看来，宇宙中并不缺乏滑稽剧。但不管好坏，他们确实帮助过我们。我们应想办法做些什么来报答这份恩惠。
descriptions.en: We have found the descendants of the species that once rendered our ancestors... lesser. These descendants are now the diminished ones. The universe, it seems, is not without a sense of irony. But for better or worse, they did help us. We should investigate what we can do to repay the favor.

descriptions.zh: 通过分析聚变引擎航迹，我们的研究部门可以确定我们的老客人究竟去了哪里，另一方面而言也就意味着我们可以开始追踪了。
descriptions.en: By analyzing the fusion drive trail our science department may figure out where our old visitors went, which in turn means that we can initiate a pursuit.

descriptions.zh: 一艘废弃的货用太空船静静地停在冰冷的太空中。它年代很久，但看上去没有损伤。我们应该派遣一支登陆队进行进一步调查。
descriptions.en: A derelict freighter ship is waiting in the cold of space. It is very old, but seemingly undamaged. We should send a boarding party to investigate closer.

descriptions.zh: 这个古老结构在有规律地放出能量震荡，期待着有人发现它。为了找出原因，我们必须允许我们的科学家在更近的距离调查。
descriptions.en: Based on the frequent energy pulse emanating from it, this old space structure wants to be found. In order to figure out why we must allow our scientist to take a closer look.

descriptions.zh: [Root.GetName]被无法控制的舞蹈困扰。我们必须在有人受伤之前调查清楚这次爆发的原因！
descriptions.en: [Root.GetName] has been beset by cases of uncontrollable dancing. We must investigate the cause of this outbreak, before anyone is hurt!

descriptions.zh: 所谓的“舞蹈瘟疫”已经对[Root.GetName]造成了巨大的苦难。我们必须尽快找到方法治愈它，否则殖民地可能崩溃！
descriptions.en: The so-called 'Dancing Plague' has caused great suffering on [Root.GetName]. We must find a way to cure it as soon as possible, or the colony may collapse!

descriptions.zh: 据信，合理运用这独特的种地质反射现象可以将普通的岩石转化成优质合金。
descriptions.en: It's thought that the unique, reflective properties of this geographical phenomenon may be harnessed in order to transmute base rocks into superior alloys.

descriptions.zh: [event_target:wenkwort_rellrait.GetName]的表面上留下了圆形的山脊，优雅地环绕着无数的火山口和山脉。这一设计是否具有什么用意？这里与这个恒星系内的园艺无人机们之间到底有什么关系？
descriptions.en: Circular ridges have been impressed upon the surface of [event_target:wenkwort_rellrait.GetName], sweeping elegantly around its myriad craters and mountains. Is there some purpose to their design? What relation might there be to the Gardening Drones in this system?

descriptions.zh:
色彩鲜艳的卷须状云团封闭了我们在[root.Capital.GetName]的恒星基地，以一种缺少规律——或许甚至是有生命——的方式从亚空间中来去。是什么导致了这种情况？

这一项目是[root.GetAllianceName]成员国进行的更广泛的科学研究的一部分。
descriptions.en:
Brightly-colored tendrils of cloud have latched onto our starbase at [root.Capital.GetName], phasing in and out of hyperspace in an erratic - or perhaps even organic - manner. What's causing this?

This project is part of a wider scientific effort being conducted by members of the [root.GetAllianceName].

descriptions.zh:
作为当前庆祝[Root.Owner.Federation.GetName]强力领导暨意识形态团结的联合行动的一部分，代表团将被派往两个成员国的首都，以监督其更紧密地融入联盟。

一旦两个成员国已被选定，文化调整项目将被视作完成。
descriptions.en:
As part of the current joint operation to celebrate the strong leadership and ideological unity of the [Root.Owner.Federation.GetName], a delegation shall be sent to two members' capitals in order to supervise their closer integration into the alliance.

Once the two member states have been chosen, the cultural adjustment program will be deemed complete.

descriptions.zh:
为了庆贺[Root.Owner.Federation.GetName]的凝聚力和实力，我们目前正在执行联合行动。作为行动的一部分，我们已经同意向[This.GetName]运送资源，以建造献给[This.Owner.GetAdj]领袖们的丰碑。

我们将为此项目献出£minerals£矿物年产量的10%。
descriptions.en:
As part of the current joint operation to celebrate the unity and strength of the [Root.Owner.Federation.GetName], we have agreed to send resources to [This.GetName] for the construction of a grand monument to our [This.Owner.GetAdj] leaders.

We will have to contribute 10% of our £minerals£ mineral output for a year to this project.

descriptions.zh:
[Root.Owner.Federation.GetName]正在举行联合军事演习，以便增强联盟内各个军队之间的凝聚力，磨练船员的技能。

演习将在联邦舰队就位后立即开始。
descriptions.en:
The [Root.Owner.Federation.GetName] is holding joint military exercises to improve cohesion within the diverse militaries in the alliance, as well as honing the skills of its crews.

The exercises will commence as soon as all federation fleets are in position.

descriptions.zh: 我们的联邦同事正在极度嘈杂的环境中努力进行挖掘工作，为协助他们，我们的任务是改进所有人的隔音罩。考古学家目前只能断断续续地轮班，暂时还没有出现身体不适的迹象。
descriptions.en: In order to assist our federation colleagues amidst exceedingly noisy conditions, we have been tasked with refining their personnel's acoustic shields. The archaeologists are currently unable to work anything more than staccato shifts before they show signs of physical distress.

descriptions.zh: 我们在[root.Federation.GetName]的同事已经开始进行下一阶段的挖掘工作，但是每个受影响的星球仍然会发出噪音，因此项目监督委员会委托我们研究这些逐渐减弱的噪音。
descriptions.en: Now that our colleagues in the [root.Federation.GetName] have begun the next stage of their excavations, the project's oversight committee has delegated us to study the waning din which still emanates from each affected world.

descriptions.zh:
为了对全新的物流标准进行试点，这一恒星基地的相关设施需要进行重大的结构性改造。

指派一艘§Y工程船§!到这个项目，确保项目按时完成！
descriptions.en:
In order to try out the new logistical standards, the relevant facilities on this starbase need to undergo some major structural alterations.

Assign a §YConstruction Ship§! to the project, and make sure it's done on time!

descriptions.zh:
为了对全新的物流标准进行试点，这一恒星基地的相关设施需要进行重大的结构性改造。多亏了本地的§H外星贸易公司§!，项目会进行的更为高效。

指派一艘§Y工程船§!到这个项目，确保项目按时完成！
descriptions.en:
In order to try out the new logistical standards, the relevant facilities on this starbase need to undergo some major structural alterations. Thanks to the local §HOffworld Trading Company§! this project will be more efficient.

Assign a §YConstruction Ship§! to the project, and make sure it's done on time!
